title: Americans Leaving America
author: Wall Street Journal
summary: Americans are leaving the country in record numbers for the first time since the Great Depression. Americans are relocating to Lisbon, Dublin, Bali, Thailand, and Albania, attracted by affordability and safety. In 2024, more people left the US than arrived—unprecedented except during the Depression. Expat relocation companies report explosive growth, targeting ordinary Americans rather than adventurous elite. Portugal has seen a 500% jump in American residents; more Americans now live in Norway than Norwegians live in America.
points: More Americans left US than arrived in 2024—first time since Great Depression
Portugal US resident population jumped 500% since 2020; up 36% in 2024 alone
Expat relocation companies organizing 57 group trips in 2026 vs 3 in 2024
Lisbon streets now echo English; Americans comprise significant share of residents
Motivations: cost of living, crime, politics, Trump election; one-in-five now want to leave
quotes: Last year the U.S. experienced something that hasn't definitively occurred since the Great Depression: More people moved out than moved in.
